plugins.name: metabob
plugins.description: Metabob code intelligence for AI agents: Code Property Graph of your repo, blast-radius impact analysis, git-history co-change prediction, agent-recorded findings shared across your org, and durable design memory — plus the working protocol (skill) that sequences it. Setup: the substrate installer writes your API key and endpoint to ~/.substrate/config.json; otherwise set METABOB_API_KEY and METABOB_ENDPOINT. Check the connection with `npx @metabob/mcp attach --check`.
